---
description: Wrap up: validation, results, presentation
agent: agent
---

Follow the definition of done in `challenge/definition-of-done.md`. 1) Run `npm run validate`. 2) Follow `skills/prepare-demo/SKILL.md`: run `npm run hackathon:results`, fill `.hackathon/presentation.md` from `evaluation/presentation-template.md`. 3) Make sure README.md is accurate. 4) Show the team a checklist with what is complete and what is not, ask them for the honest reflection answers (what worked, what did not, would you repeat), and write them into `.hackathon/RESULTS.md`. 5) Offer to commit on the team branch. Be honest about gaps.
